project_type: Python ICT Trading Bot with MT5 integration, converting to MQL5 Expert Advisor
build_system: No build system for Python. MQL5 file will be compiled in MT5 Strategy Tester (not available here).
test_framework: pytest for Python tests in tests/ directory. MQL5 validation is syntax/logic only.
build_command: N/A - MQL5 compilation requires MetaEditor which is not available in this environment
test_command: N/A - Strategy Tester runs inside MT5 platform
verification_instructions: Verify the .mq5 file is syntactically correct MQL5, contains identical logic to the Python modules, and all input parameters match.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - this is a code generation task producing a single .mq5 file
environment_constraints: Cannot compile MQL5 in this environment. Cannot run MT5 Strategy Tester. Validation is code-level only.
contribution_requirements: Place ICT_Bot.mq5 at the root of the repository. Commit to main branch. Do NOT push.
key_patterns: The Python bot uses a sequential state machine: Liquidity Sweep -> MSS -> FVG -> Entry. All logic modules are pure functions operating on OHLC DataFrames. The entry model buffers candles (max 500) and only trades during Kill Zones. Risk is 1% per trade, 3% max daily loss.
relevant_files: ict_bot/entry_model.py - Main state machine (WAITING_FOR_SWEEP -> WAITING_FOR_MSS -> WAITING_FOR_FVG -> READY_TO_ENTER)
ict_bot/liquidity.py - Equal highs/lows detection and liquidity sweep detection
ict_bot/market_structure.py - Swing point detection (lookback=5), BOS detection, MSS detection
ict_bot/fvg.py - FVG detection (3-candle pattern) and iFVG detection
ict_bot/order_blocks.py - Order block identification (last opposing candle before BOS/MSS)
ict_bot/kill_zones.py - Kill zone time windows in ET (Asian 20:00-00:00, London 02:00-05:00, NY AM 10:00-11:00, NY PM 13:30-16:00)
ict_bot/ote.py - OTE zone calculation (62-79% Fibonacci retracement)
ict_bot/premium_discount.py - Premium/discount zone classification relative to equilibrium
ict_bot/risk_management.py - Position sizing (1% risk), daily loss limit (3%), SL/TP validation
ict_bot/backtester.py - Backtesting engine with trade simulation, HTF range derivation from daily OHLC
main.py - Live trading loop and backtest runner
config/settings.yaml - Configuration with kill zone times, risk params, symbol US100
directory_structure: ict_bot/ contains all trading logic modules. config/ has YAML settings. tests/ has pytest tests. main.py is the entry point.
